h: The Shabbos of Shemittah Reveals the Hidden Divine Name

p: In the Baal HaTurim (beginning of the parshah):
"He juxtaposed the blasphemer to 'at Har Sinai,' etc.,
the Sages transmit to their students
therefore he juxtaposed Shemittah to it."
after all, from the wording of the Gemara (Kiddushin 71a)
it implies once in seven years,
and not specifically in the Shemittah year;
so what connection does it have to Shemittah?
But in the Gemara there it says:
"And some say: twice in a seven-year cycle.
It stands to reason like the one who says
And it is difficult either way:
if it was permitted to reveal it
יָכוֹל לִהְיוֹת פַּעֲמַיִם בַּשָּׁבוּעַ גַּם כֵּן
it could also be twice in the cycle;
and if it must be concealed,
how was it permitted to reveal it even once?
or every three and a half years?
on what is said, "a Shabbos unto Hashem,"
"as is said of the Shabbos of Creation."
is like the Mikdash in space;
and in the Beis HaMikdash it was permitted
to reveal and pronounce the Name with its letters:
the Kohen Gadol in the Kodesh HaKodashim,
and all the Kohanim in Bircas Kohanim.
But according to this it is difficult:
in what way is Shemittah stronger than Shabbos?
it was not permitted to pronounce the Name with its letters,
and Shemittah is learned only from the Shabbos of Creation;
so how can its power exceed that from which it is learned?
it says in the Ramban, of blessed memory,
on the verse "a Shabbos unto Hashem":
to a great secret among the secrets of the Torah, etc.,
and the secret of the days of the world
is alluded to in this place, etc.;
for the six days of Creation
are the days of the world,
for it will be a Shabbos for the great Name,
On the seventh day what would they say?
'A psalm, a song for the day of Shabbos'
in the creation of all the days of the world, etc.
And perhaps our Rabbis alluded to this
and all were transmitted to Moshe
is one gate of the house;
and so they made known to him
except for the Yovel, which is holy,"
It is already mentioned in the Recanati
that what they said in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 97a):
one thousand years out of seven thousand years"
and afterward will be the holy Yovel,
when all souls will return to their root,
"You shall return, each man to his holding, etc."
there will be six thousand years,
a day that is entirely Shabbos.
כִּי יוֹמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
For the day of the Holy One, blessed be He,
"For a thousand years in Your eyes
and Shabbos is a semblance of the World to Come,
one-sixtieth of the World to Come
And afterward there will be another Shemittah
there will be the holy Yovel.
And to Moshe Rabbeinu were revealed
all of existence from beginning to end,
And this is what they said (Rosh Hashanah 21b):
and all were given to Moshe
as the Ramban, of blessed memory, wrote.
And this is what is said of Shemittah:
just as is said of the Shabbos of Creation";
is a semblance of the seventh millennium,
just as the Shabbos of Creation
is a semblance of the World to Come.
And in the Gemara (end of Berachos, 64a):
nor in the World to Come,
he will appear before God in Tziyon.'"
then "he will appear before God in Tziyon,"
"And it shall be, every New Moon
And this is "he will appear before God in Tziyon,"
in the manner of what they said:
"Tziyon, the dwelling place of Your glory";
and then they will have rest.
to the Kohen Gadol in the Kodesh HaKodashim,
and likewise to the Kohanim in Bircas Kohanim
to mention the Name with its letters.
And regarding Rabbi Yishmael the Kohen Gadol
since the entire Shemittah year is
a semblance of the World to Come
the Shabbasos of the Shemittah year
are like the World to Come,
and it was permitted to reveal the Explicit Name.
And this is what it says:
that the Sages transmit it to their students
that is, on the Shabbasos of the Shemittah year;
And "some say twice in the cycle"
הוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (בְּרֵאשִׁית א, לא)
this is in the manner of what is said (Bereishis 1:31):
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
"And God saw all that He had made,
and behold, it was very good";
and this was said on the sixth day,
in the added portion of Shabbos.
the Arizal, of blessed memory, reckoned
as having a radiance from Shabbos,
at the levels of nefesh, ruach and neshamah;
So too the days of Mashiach,
which are at the end of the sixth millennium,
are the added portion of Shabbos.
שֶׁאֵין בָּהֶם לֹא זְכוּת וְלֹא חוֹבָה
in which there is neither merit nor obligation";
שֶׁאָז גַּם כֵּן לֹא יִהְיֶה יֵצֶר הָרָע
that then too there will be no yetzer hara,
and it is then permitted to reveal the Name.
on Friday, in the added portion of Shabbos,
it is also permitted to reveal it.
"It stands to reason like the one who says
that in the days of Mashiach too
it will not be fully revealed,
but only in the seventh millennium;
and in the days of Mashiach there will be
only the victory over the nations of the world,
in Gan Eden at that time,
אַף שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה לוֹ יֵצֶר הָרָע
even though he had no yetzer hara,
that it was permitted to reveal it
namely the Shabbasos of the Shemittah year.
And this is what the Baal HaTurim says,
that Shemittah was juxtaposed to the blasphemer,
